tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Mid tone of the lit wall behind every screen (sampled from the reference). Never place text on it directly.

tokens.name: ground-glow-warm
tokens.usage: Warm light pooling at the top-left of the wall (large, soft).

tokens.name: ground-glow-cool
tokens.usage: Dark slate shade on the top-right of the wall. The light comes from the top-left, so shadows fall down-right.

tokens.name: bokeh-pink
tokens.usage: Out-of-focus pink light spot behind the glass (lower right). Decorative.

tokens.name: bokeh-blue
tokens.usage: Out-of-focus blue light spot behind the glass. Decorative.

tokens.name: bokeh-violet
tokens.usage: Out-of-focus lilac light spot behind the glass. Decorative.

tokens.name: bokeh-teal
tokens.usage: Out-of-focus teal light spot behind the glass. Decorative.

tokens.name: shade
tokens.usage: Colour of every drop shadow: warm mauve, cast down-right (light from the top-left).

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Top-left stop of the big glass sheet and cards: nearly clear, so the lit wall shows through.

tokens.name: glass-2
tokens.usage: Bottom-right stop of sheet and card fill.

tokens.name: glass-card
tokens.usage: Top-left stop of a floating card: clear glass with a little light caught in it.

tokens.name: glass-card-2
tokens.usage: Middle/bottom stop of a floating card (nearly clear).

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: The thin lighter band just under a floating card: the thickness of its glass.

tokens.name: glass-strong
tokens.usage: Milky glass of beads: buttons, fields, chips, tiles, round buttons, selected tab. Slight pink warmth.

tokens.name: glass-strong-2
tokens.usage: Lower stop of bead fill, so beads look thicker at the top.

tokens.name: glass-stroke
tokens.usage: Bright rim on the lit (top) edge of glass.

tokens.name: glass-stroke-dim
tokens.usage: Rim on the sides of glass.

tokens.name: glass-stroke-tint
tokens.usage: Lilac light caught on the bottom-right rim.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers inside cards and the outer edge of fields (meets 3:1 with `line-strong` where it marks a control).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders that must be seen: toggle track off, checkbox off. 3:1 on `ground` and on glass.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, numbers and body text on `ground` and every glass surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, captions, inactive nav labels, placeholders on glass and `ground` (≥4.5:1).

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Brand violet as TEXT or icon: links, 'In progress' text, active chart line. On glass, `ground` and `violet-soft`.

tokens.name: violet-fill
tokens.usage: Top stop of the primary liquid button (sampled #8d70e7 from the reference).

tokens.name: violet-fill-2
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of the primary gradient.

tokens.name: violet-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted chip background behind `violet` text; selected-row tint.

tokens.name: on-violet
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `violet-fill` (5.7:1).

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Teal as TEXT or icon: secondary actions, conversation icons.

tokens.name: teal-fill
tokens.usage: Top stop of the secondary liquid button (sampled #5ca2b9–#60bdc0).

tokens.name: teal-fill-2
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of the secondary gradient.

tokens.name: teal-glow
tokens.usage: Glow and sheen on teal fills and teal icon tiles only. Never text.

tokens.name: on-teal
tokens.usage: Label on the secondary button; always semibold with the soft text shadow.

tokens.name: magenta
tokens.usage: AI Receptionist identity colour: its icon tile glyph and its chart series. Icon/text on glass.

tokens.name: indigo
tokens.usage: Analytics identity colour: chart icon glyph, second chart series.

tokens.name: icon-violet-a
tokens.usage: Icon gradient start, bookings tile.

tokens.name: icon-violet-b
tokens.usage: Icon gradient end, bookings tile.

tokens.name: icon-teal-a
tokens.usage: Icon gradient start, conversations tile.

tokens.name: icon-teal-b
tokens.usage: Icon gradient end, conversations tile.

tokens.name: icon-magenta-a
tokens.usage: Icon gradient start, AI Receptionist tile.

tokens.name: icon-magenta-b
tokens.usage: Icon gradient end, AI Receptionist tile.

tokens.name: icon-indigo-a
tokens.usage: Icon gradient start, analytics tile.

tokens.name: icon-indigo-b
tokens.usage: Icon gradient end, analytics tile.

tokens.name: aurora-peach
tokens.usage: Promo card light, top-left (sampled).

tokens.name: aurora-lilac
tokens.usage: Promo card light, middle (sampled).

tokens.name: aurora-blue
tokens.usage: Promo card light, bottom-right (sampled).

tokens.name: cyan-wash
tokens.usage: Top of the cyan feature card from the kit (gradient to glass).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive change text and check marks, on `success-soft` or glass. Always with an up arrow or word.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of positive trend chips.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs-attention text, on `warning-soft` or glass. Always with an icon or word.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of needs-attention chips.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, failed sends, negative change; on `danger-soft` or glass. Always with an icon or word.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of error chips and field error tints.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring on every interactive element, offset 2px. ≥3:1 on `ground` and glass in both themes.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", "SF Pro Text", "Plus Jakarta Sans", system-ui, "Segoe UI", sans-serif

styles.name: number-xl
styles.usage: The big figure on a StatCard. Tabular numerals.

styles.name: number-lg
styles.usage: Metric values in an AnalyticsCard row.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The VENTRA wordmark only. Always uppercase.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: One per screen: the page title.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section titles and large card titles.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: StatCard label, list-row title, dialog title.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The AI booked a free trial for Thursday at 6 pm.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Metric labels, nav labels, field labels.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Eyebrows above a hero title. Uppercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; chip padding block.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked cards on phones; nav item padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page side gutter on phones; field inner padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card inner padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card inner padding on desktop; gap between card groups.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section spacing.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chart plot area, small tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Icon tiles (56px).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The outer app frame and bottom nav bar.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, chips, toggles, tabs, round icon buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: The big sheet and cards: bright top rim, long soft mauve shadow cast down-right.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Beads (buttons, fields, chips, tiles, round buttons, knob): puffy top highlight, darker underside, shadow cast down-right.

tokens.name: shadow-violet
tokens.usage: Primary liquid button and active nav pill: sheen, deep bottom, violet glow cast down-right.

tokens.name: shadow-teal
tokens.usage: Secondary liquid button.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Floating cards: bright top rim, glass edge band and its underside line, a long shadow cast down-right with a darker core so the card sits well above the sheet.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter blur for the sheet and cards (with saturate 150%).

tokens.name: blur-raised
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter blur for beads.

tokens.name: blur-card
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter blur for floating cards: lower than the sheet so the wall shows through clearly.
